elements.description: Streaming code with syntax colours, Copy, Apply, and a line diff against the current file.

properties.name: code
properties.description: The code; it may grow every frame while streaming

properties.name: language
properties.description: Language for the colours: ts, tsx, js, jsx, py, json, html, xml, css, sh/bash, or plain

properties.name: filename
properties.description: File name shown in the head, e.g. "src/auth/session.ts"

properties.name: current
properties.description: The file as it is now. When given, a Diff button shows the changes the code would make

properties.name: view
properties.description: "code" or "diff". Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: The code is still coming in: a caret blinks at the end, Diff and Apply wait

properties.name: applied
properties.description: The code has been applied: Apply turns into a disabled "Applied"

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: Cap the body's height in px (0: grow with the code); a capped body scrolls and follows the end while streaming

properties.name: bare
properties.description: No tray or card around it – for use inside another component's card

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The code was copied to the clipboard ({ text: string })

events.name: tc-apply
events.description: Apply was pressed ({ code: string, filename: string, language: string })

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: Code or Diff was picked ({ view: "code" | "diff" }); cancelable

functions.name: codeBlockLanguageLabel
functions.description: The language's display name: "ts" → "TypeScript"; unknown ones as given, empty → "Text"

functions.name: codeBlockTokens
functions.description: The code as lines of coloured tokens – what the element renders, for tests and other renderers

functions.name: codeBlockDiff
functions.description:
A line diff of two texts: inline-diff's Myers diff (diffWords) run over one token per distinct line, read back as
rows. Within a change, the removed lines come first, then the added ones.

props.name: view
props.description: "code" or "diff" (controlled) – Diff shows the changes against `current`

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with "code" or "diff" when the Diff button is toggled

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the code after Copy put it on the clipboard

props.name: onApply
props.description: Shows the Apply button; called with the code, the file name and the language

changelog: `tc-code-block` – a streaming code block: a small tokenizer per language (TS/JS, Python, JSON, HTML, CSS, shell) re-highlighting only changed lines, Copy, Apply, and a line diff against `current` with folded unchanged runs. Toolbar keyboard; `tc-view-change`, `tc-copy`, `tc-apply`.

`tc-artifact-panel` – what a run produced: a list, a preview per kind (Markdown text, code through `tc-code-block`, images, tables from CSV), versions with a diff against the one before, and download (a Blob by default, cancelable).
